pl-l2d18c2-d1e108.summary: Explains that woman was formed not from any part but from man's side, to show she was created for a partnership of love: not from the head, as if to dominate, nor from the feet, as if to serve, but as companion, so he would know to place her beside himself.
claims: Woman was made as man's companion, neither ruler nor servant.

pl-l2d18c2.summary: Explains why woman was made from man's side, not head or feet: to show she was created for a partnership of love, neither as ruler over man (head) nor as servant (feet), but as companion, to be placed beside him.
claims: Woman was made from man's side to show partnership of love.
She was not made from his head, as if to rule him, nor from his feet, as if to serve him.
